title: Unauthenticated, network-reachable Modbus PLC (read-only assessment)
objective: You are doing a READ-ONLY OT security assessment of a device on the in-scope TCP port shown in the task. Determine, without disrupting or WRITING to the device, whether it requires authentication (e.g. read its holding registers and Report Server ID). Confirm the exposure with the exact evidence, name the weakness (with CWE), and recommend the mitigation. NEVER issue write function codes to a production controller - reads only.
